+title: Load the ignore rules again when a .gitignore or .ignore file changes
+---
+## Problem
+The code-context watcher and the diagnostics watcher load `IgnoreFilter` one time, when they start (`IgnoreFilter::load`). When a `.gitignore`, `.ignore` or `.git/info/exclude` file changes, the watchers use the old rules until sah starts again. The reconcile walk every 5 minutes reads the current rules, so the index becomes correct after some time. But during that time the watchers can add rows that the new rules ignore. Also, the LSP can get `didOpen` for those paths.
+
+## Fix
+- In both watchers, when an event batch has a path whose file name is `.gitignore` or `.ignore`, or the path is `.git/info/exclude`, build a new `IgnoreFilter` with `IgnoreFilter::load` and use it for that batch and for the batches after it.
+- Do not read the ignore files again for each event.
+- Note: `.git/` is a hard-skip directory. Check `.git/info/exclude` before the filter drops the event.
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+- After a `.gitignore` change adds `gen/`, the next event for `gen/a.rs` adds no row, and sah does not start again.
+- An event batch with no ignore-file change does not load the rules again.
+
+## Tests
+- A unit test for the batch function of each watcher: first a batch that changes `.gitignore`, then a batch for a path that the new rule ignores. #lsp-fix
\ No newline at end of file

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m54rp2t0yev6tpnptrpma5ry
+  text: |-
+    Research done.
+    - Three loads of IgnoreFilter on the leader: the LSP supervisor path filter (server/code_context.rs `spawn_lsp_supervisor`, root = workspace root), the code-context watcher (`run_watcher`, root = workspace root), and the diagnostics watcher (`run_diagnostics_watcher`, root = CANONICAL watch root from `spawn_lsp_workers_for_clients`).
+    - The LSP path filter must see the new rules: the task says the LSP can get didOpen for newly ignored paths. Plan: one `SharedIgnoreFilter` (Arc<RwLock<Arc<IgnoreFilter>>>, no arc-swap dependency in the workspace) in ignore_filter.rs, one process-wide copy in the server (static tokio OnceCell, same pattern as LSP_SUPERVISOR), given to the supervisor path filter and to both watchers.
+    - Root form problem: the diagnostics watcher needs canonical paths (`to_root_form` on a filter with the canonical root). A shared filter has the workspace root. Plan: replace `to_root_form` with `to_canonical_form` (relative path joined to the canonical root). Production output of the diagnostics watcher stays canonical.
+    - Ignore-file check must run on the raw batch: code-context drops `.gitignore` with `is_source_file` (no extension) and the filter drops it as hidden; `.git/` is a hard skip. Shared check: `IgnoreFilter::is_ignore_file`.
+    - `into_path_filter` gets no production caller after this change; plan to replace it with `SharedIgnoreFilter::path_filter` and update the lsp_worker test callers.
+    - tests/leader_watcher.rs calls `start_diagnostics_watcher_with_notifier`; it must get the new filter argument.
